PUZZLEPAW.name: Cooper Cat
PUZZLEPAW.src: zynga.com Toon Blast page: Cooper Cat, one of the three main characters (Bruno Bear, Cooper Cat, Wally Wolf) (notes/TTWO.md)
PUZZLEPAW.story: Cooper Cat, in gloves and trousers, lines up petals in threes.
PUZZLEPAW.look: A light silver-grey cartoon cat with a white muzzle, fluffy white cheek tufts and a white bib, wearing white cartoon gloves and blue cartoon trousers, cheerful. No text or logo.
PUZZLEPAW.why: He follows Cooper Cat, the grey cat character in the company's Zynga puzzle game Toon Blast: light silver-grey with a white muzzle, cheek tufts and bib, in his cartoon gloves and trousers.

CLOCKPAW.name: Chik
CLOCKPAW.story: Chik, a ginger tabby in a teal shirt, trots home when work ends.
CLOCKPAW.why: She follows Chik, the office-worker cat in SK hynix's own newsroom and YouTube shorts, drawn as a ginger tabby in a teal collared shirt as the checker saw it (the notes call Chik a leopard cat).

INKCAP.name: AMR Cat
INKCAP.src: Pfizer Japan children's video on antimicrobial resistance: 'AMR猫' (AMR Cat), 2022-11-10 (notes/PFIZER.md)
INKCAP.story: AMR Cat, a round cream cat with a charcoal cap, dozes by the mushrooms.
INKCAP.why: She follows AMR Cat, the cat that hosts Pfizer Japan's children's video on antimicrobial resistance: a round cream cat with a charcoal cap, back patches and a hooked tail.

NIGHTSEAT.name: Pepper
NIGHTSEAT.src: rivian.com/stories/pet-day-rivian-2026: 'Pepper, a cat, sits on the headrest.' (notes/RIVN.md)
NIGHTSEAT.story: Pepper, a black cat in an aqua collar, takes the highest perch.
NIGHTSEAT.why: She follows Pepper, the black cat in Rivian's own National Pet Day story: slim, gold-green eyes and an aqua patterned collar.

JOWLS.name: Tom Rutgers
JOWLS.src: J&J heritage site photo of 'a cat named "Tom Rutgers"' (notes/JNJ.md)
JOWLS.story: Tom Rutgers, a big jowly grey cat, sits still as an old photo.
JOWLS.why: He follows Tom Rutgers, the big jowly cat in an archive photo on J&J's own heritage page. The photo is black and white, so the grey shade and eye colour are guesses.

HEARTHBIB.name: Mittens
HEARTHBIB.src: rumble.com licensed clip 'cat stands...' (cat named Mittens) (notes/RUM.md)
HEARTHBIB.story: Mittens, a fluffy brown tabby, stands up tall by the hearth.
HEARTHBIB.why: She follows Mittens, the cat in a licensed clip on Rumble's official YouTube channel: a fluffy brown tabby-and-white cat standing on her hind legs by a stone hearth.

STRPNOSE.name: Ruby
STRPNOSE.src: The Argus 2023-03-23: 'Erin Johansen's black-and-white tuxedo cat Ruby went missing' (notes/GRND.md)
STRPNOSE.story: Ruby, a tuxedo cat with a white nose stripe, strolls the path.
STRPNOSE.why: She follows Ruby, the real missing tuxedo cat that was put on a Grindr profile (The Argus, 2023): a black tuxedo with a thin white nose stripe.

TOUSLE.name: Cowardly Lion
TOUSLE.src: Sphere's show 'The Wizard of Oz at Sphere' and its official store socks: the Cowardly Lion (notes/SPHR.md)
TOUSLE.story: The Cowardly Lion, a bow in his curly mane, hides in the flowers.
TOUSLE.look: A gentle, shy lion with a big curly russet mane tied with a small red bow on top, a tawny-gold body and a tufted tail, sweet timid face; a real lion with no human features or costume. No text or logo.
TOUSLE.why: He follows the Cowardly Lion of Sphere's own show 'The Wizard of Oz at Sphere': a shy lion with a curly russet mane tied with a red bow.

LACQUER.story: Lacquer, a glossy black cat with a wide head, greets visitors.
LACQUER.look: A sleek, fashionable solid black cat with a very wide, rounded-square head, large bright eyes and short pointed ears set wide apart. No text or logo.
LACQUER.why: She follows the black-cat mascot of Alibaba's Tmall marketplace: a sleek black cat with a very wide, rounded-square head and big bright eyes. The mascot's name is the marketplace's brand, so the name is unchanged.

SAFFWHISK.story: Saffron, a tiger with long white whiskers, stares down the sprinkler.
SAFFWHISK.look: A Bengal tiger with a burnt-orange coat, bold black stripes, white brows and cheeks and very long white whiskers. No text or logo.
SAFFWHISK.why: He follows the AI tiger in Figure 1 of Nebius's own blog: a burnt-orange tiger with black stripes, white brows and very long white whiskers.

TALLYSPOT.story: Tally, a cheetah with dark tear-marks, counts the pond's goldfish.
TALLYSPOT.look: A lean cheetah with a sandy-gold coat of solid black spots, black tear-marks from the eyes to the mouth and a ringed tail. No text or logo.
TALLYSPOT.why: It follows IBM's own cheetah codename for its database server, drawn as a cheetah: sandy-gold with solid black spots, tear-marks and a ringed tail.

VELVETPAW.story: Velvet, a black panther, watches the pond with gold eyes.
VELVETPAW.look: A black panther (black leopard) with a glossy black coat whose faint ghost rosettes show in the light, and yellow-green eyes. No text or logo.
VELVETPAW.why: She follows the panther in the company's own targeting-pod export name, drawn as a black panther: glossy black with ghost rosettes.

SUNSTRETCH.story: Sunstretch, a red tiger, starts each day with a long stretch.
SUNSTRETCH.look: A tiger in a bold red-orange coat with thick black stripes, stretching forward in a long stretch. No text or logo.
SUNSTRETCH.why: She follows the red tiger print of the company's 2022 Lunar New Year collection, drawn as a red-orange tiger with bold black stripes.

SANDSTEP.story: Sandstep, a tawny mountain lion, trots over the footbridge.
SANDSTEP.look: A mountain lion (cougar) with a plain tawny coat, cream chest and muzzle and a dark tail tip. No text or logo.
SANDSTEP.why: She follows the mountain lions in Snap's own 2022 AR lens, drawn as a mountain lion: tawny, with a cream chest and a dark tail tip.

SORRELPAW.story: Sorrel, a sleek lioness, creeps low through the pond reeds.
SORRELPAW.look: A proud adult lioness with a sleek sand-fawn coat, no mane, a pale muzzle and golden eyes, head raised. No ring, text or logo.
SORRELPAW.why: She follows MGM's 2019 lioness logo, drawn as a proud sand-fawn lioness with no mane; the logo's ring and text are left out.

STUBTAIL.story: Stubtail, a bobcat with tufted ears, naps on the woodpile.
STUBTAIL.look: A bobcat with a tawny-grey spotted coat, black-tufted ears, a facial ruff and a short bobbed tail. No text or logo.
STUBTAIL.why: It follows AMD's own 'Bobcat' CPU-core codename, drawn as a bobcat: tawny-grey spots, black ear tufts, a facial ruff and a bobbed tail.

RIMESTRIPE.story: Rimestripe, a glowing ice-blue tiger, pads a loop round the pond.
RIMESTRIPE.look: A glowing ice-blue translucent tiger with pale silver-blue stripes, softly luminous like crystal ice. No text or logo.
RIMESTRIPE.why: It follows the glowing ice-blue tiger in Arm's own 2015 graphics demo, drawn as that glowing ice-blue tiger.

DROWSEPAW.story: Drowse, an armoured lion, sleeps all afternoon.
DROWSEPAW.look: A calm lion lying down, with a deep tawny coat, a dark brown mane, dark grey armour plates on its shoulders and chest and one glowing green eye. No letters, symbols or logo.
DROWSEPAW.why: He follows the armoured lion in the company's own @cypherpunk posts: deep tawny, a dark brown mane, dark armour plates and one glowing green eye. The 'Z' mark is left out.

SCUFFPAW.story: Scuff, a brown tabby with white paws, rides his skateboard.
SCUFFPAW.look: A sturdy brown tabby cat with a white nose stripe, white chest and white paws, riding a plain wooden skateboard. No text or logo.
SCUFFPAW.why: He follows the skateboarding cat in a video on GoPro's own YouTube channel: a sturdy brown tabby with a white nose stripe, chest and paws, on his skateboard.
